answer: The vine test I would run is Marathon finish certificate: a race finished with an official chip time, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a race finished with an official chip time is per-account by construction, and the dune is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The cipher grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
